note: Spike M1.14: WorkManager process reuse and in-process warm execution benchmark certified on Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra

controls.name: C_raw_counter_drifts_under_reuse
controls.must_fire_because: In-process reuse must advance NEXT_VARIABLE_ID across iterations, producing distinct raw hashes for variable probes
controls.can_fail_because: a cold restart per job would reset NEXT_VARIABLE_ID to 1 on every iteration
controls.null_must_contain: 1 distinct raw hash across 100 runs, which would indicate cold process restart rather than reuse
controls.detail: P5 variable probe produced 100 distinct raw hashes across 100 iterations

controls.name: C_canonical_digest_invariant
controls.must_fire_because: Canonicalisation must collapse process-global variable counter drift into exactly 1 bit-identical digest
controls.can_fail_because: canon could fail to renumber variables in first-appearance order
controls.null_must_contain: multiple distinct canon hashes, indicating history dependence leaking through canon
controls.detail: All 5 program suites produced exactly 1 distinct canonical digest across 100 iterations

controls.name: C_zero_memory_leakage
controls.must_fire_because: Long-lived process reuse must not leak memory across sequential discrete job evaluations
controls.can_fail_because: retaining ASTs, spaces, or cyclic closure references would increase VmRSS
controls.null_must_contain: linearly growing RSS (>5 MB) across 100 iterations
controls.detail: Memory delta from iteration 10 to 100 was 128 kB over 450 jobs (VmRSS: 11880 kB constant, <=0.3 kB/job arena page alignment)

controls.name: C_inprocess_warm_speedup
controls.must_fire_because: In-process warm execution must demonstrate >20x speedup over cold-start process spawn on Snapdragon 8 Elite
controls.can_fail_because: in-process overhead or lock contention could exceed process spawn
controls.detail: Warm in-process execution achieved 73.0x speedup over cold process spawn

falsifiers.name: F_linear_memory_growth
falsifiers.can_fail_because: Delta RSS between iteration 10 and 100 exceeds 5000 kB (>50 kB/iter linear leak)
falsifiers.detail: Delta RSS was 128 kB (falsifier did NOT fire, memory is bounded)
falsifiers.refutes: Process-reuse memory stability claim: if fired, memory leaks linearly per job making WorkManager reuse unviable
falsifiers.fires_when: Delta RSS between iteration 10 and 100 exceeds 5000 kB (>50 kB/iter linear leak)
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F_canonical_divergence
falsifiers.can_fail_because: Any program exhibits more than 1 distinct canonical digest across 100 iterations
falsifiers.null_must_contain: multiple distinct canon hashes across iterations
falsifiers.detail: Canonical digests remained 100% bit-identical (distinct=1 for all suites; falsifier did NOT fire)
falsifiers.refutes: Bit-identical canonical digest invariance across process reuse: if fired, position in process alters canonical output
falsifiers.fires_when: Any program exhibits more than 1 distinct canonical digest across 100 iterations
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: If canonical digests diverge across positions in a single process or memory grows unbounded, the process-reuse claim is refuted
